name: Birthday Voyage
description: OnePieceDex turns one! Sail from East Blue to the New World, collect Birthday tokens and celebrate with the whole crew.
final_message: You sailed all the way to the New World. Happy birthday, OnePieceDex! 🎂
notes: The token is a placeholder: replace venustoken by the real Birthday token, then load the file again. The Last Present counts any Craft until it points at the collector of the token frame.
